scientific_integrity: The exact equivariant characters and quotient dimensions were computed from all 48 signed coordinate automorphisms and verified using cellular chain maps, closed face-product cycles, modular rank bounds and irreducible-character inner products. General 2009 ordered face-torus theorem is acknowledged as prior work. The 55 face-pair tori have five group orbits, with four signed-exchange orbits and one 24-element square–hexagon orbit yielding a primitive integral invariant generator.
scientific_limitations: The exact new result concerns the full rational homology representation for one finite truncated-octahedral graph, not a uniform family.
The face-torus integral basis and general nonequivariant machinery have prior precedents; they are not presented as novel.
First integral homology torsion/lattice, cohomology ring, quotient fundamental groups, and quotient homotopy types are not determined.
An unindexed equivalent result remains a publication-priority risk, and independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Full octahedral symmetry of two-particle homology on the truncated octahedron
